Dialogue: So, how do we speed this crater cooling business along?
I say we increase coolant distribution!
It's altogether too hot here!
Nothin' a good dose o' coolant won't fix!
I think we should double up on observation drone patrols.
Can't quite...reach...
If only I was an ilm or two taller!
Time to get going.
Ungh... W-Wait...!
A nibble on a nice nourishing carrot'll soon boost your strength!
Vessel 7 ought to be back soon...
The mechanism's completely fried... Better bring it back to base for repair.
I don't want to see you clambering into the cockpit again! Are we clear?
Forgive me I don't quite believe you...
Listen, I've got some errands to run. No funny business while I'm gone!
As crystal!
Toodle-oo!
Surely a little peek at the cockpit won't do any harm...
What's all this!?
I knew I couldn't trust you!
Wahoo! This is so much fun!
It's not safe up there! Besides, you can hardly reach the controls!
Sorry, sorry... The cockpit was calling out to me!
Better run a quick systems check.
Fully functional.
Now for a test flight.
Here goes!
Flawless!
Given the present gravitational anomalies, proper maintenance is key...
Hmm... Seems fit enough.
Let's see how you fly, shall we?
Off you go!
Excellent. Just as I'd hoped.
You like the new mechs, eh?
...Something tells me this bears repeating.
No touching. I'll be back in a moment, so behave yourself.
They're marvelous!
Of course! I shall content myself with gazing upon it.
...Or will I?
Oh, you fluffy rascal! I knew it!
I told you, no touching!
\\<maniacal Loporrit giggling>

All right, I'm coming out─
Er...I may be stuck. Help?
...HEEELP!!!

Soil readings normal.
So far, so good.
If worse comes to worst, we can always dispatch the mechs.
What do these mechs look like, anyway?
Nothing like a special operation to get the blood pumping!
These vacuum suits are a sight to behold...
Can't let the mechs have all the glory!
Mission complete!
Tremendous work, truly.
Seems we're on the cusp of an irregular spongoi infestation.
Should we deploy the mechs for extermination?
Which mechs will they wheel out for this?
Let's crush 'em flat!
Leave the mechs to do their work while we take care of ours.
We'll handle the puny ones!
Great teamwork! Thanks again.
I'd love to pilot one of those things sometime.
Should I register my regulator...?
Where are you hiding, Calyx!?
Shale and Sphene shouldn't be far behind.
And so the trap was sprung, as expected.
There's more work to be done up top!
There's more work to be done up top!
Thank you for keeping me from harm.
Yip! Yip yip!
A marvelous festival, isn't it, Rudy?
Our wooden creations are full of warmth and character.
Everything is proudly grown by our very own botanists.
Something to wet your whistle and warm you up?
Would you like to meet our chocobos?
The punch is so good!
Seriously!
A successful hunt! Well done, my friend!
A hunter must not waste! Carve Arkveld's hide, and take what you can!
For me? Isainne, you shouldn't have!
I have a little something for you too, Kamlito!
Very well, I shall go and get some too.
You really ought to try this punch, Mother!
I wonder what the other ones taste like!
What a doting mother the guildmaster is!
Do sample the new kinds of kinderpunsch as well.
Look, look! It's a fluffy little helper!
Oh, and with sweet treats!
Take your time, my boy.
I can't decide what to get him as a souvenir...
Witness Blitzen's spectacular illusions!
Gwoooaaah!
Whoa!
So sparkly!
Ooh, I'd love to try that!
Let's go and get some!
They even have Ul'dahn punch!
Hm. Not my style.
I think you'd look quite fetching in that red, Radovan.
A seasonal market! What a wonderful idea!
Perhaps I should try my hand at a warm beverage too.
Was worth makin' the trip, eh?
Indeed. Let's go and have a mug ourselves, shall we?
Ahhh, so blessedly warm...
I must say this is really thoughtful.
We picked a good time to visit!
I just got this really tasty drink!
Oh, how nice!
Shall we go and find something to eat, too?
Welcome to the Starlight Stalls!
Ho ho ho! How wonderful to see the stalls so lively!
\\<sniff> \\<sniff> Mroww...
So, what do you think of this little gift from Tural?
It's...\\<crunch>...delicious! We would love for you to...\\<munch>...have a stall here!
Well now, do you have your eye on this taco, cat?
It would be nice to spend this magical time with someone special...
I'm on my second mug!
Can I tempt you with another?
Oh, you do spoil me...!
I should take a slice for Kupka Kupp...but which one?
Kweh, kweh!♪
What a handsomely decorated cake, kupo!
I understand this need for cake on a deep and spiritual level...
Now this is an intriguin' recipe...
Aren't you having any?
What need have I of cake, when I have your sweet love?
It would be lovely to share a cake like this with everyone in Werlyt...
I'll see to procuring some baking equipment.
Then I'll wipe your tears─you needn't wolf it down so!
It's so good I could cry...!
Well, if this ain't proper bene!
So this is the height of Gridanian sophistication...!
Phew... \\<wheeze>
Almost done with this pile.
The snow keeps piling up...
At least all this shoveling keeps me warm.
The snow doesn't look so heavy when it falls.
I shall sleep well tonight!
I think something is buried here, too.
We won't know until the snow is gone.
Take that to the storehouse out back.
Understood.
Good work today. You've earned a short rest.
I could keep going...but I suppose rest will help me come back even stronger.
If only we had more help...
I'll ask a friend of mine if he wants to join us.
Is anything so sweet as this!?
Pace yourself. There will be more work to do tomorrow.
We're running low on supplies.
Understood. I'll arrange a delivery from Shelter.
Would you like to see us chisel the stone?
The altar is complete at last. May the ritual go well.
The spirits look so happy...
It's almost mealtime. I should begin preparations.
I suppose it's time to bring the corn to the kirkahryar house.
Once work is done, I can go play with the spirits...
Is there enough corn?
We must pour our hearts and souls into every batch.
It's breathtaking...
Indeed. A job well done.
Time to play! Time to play!
Yes, yes. Just give me a few moments to catch my breath.
Is this...us?
The spitting image, don't you agree?
Press this, and...
The flowers!
So pretty!
Magnificent, indeed.
It's as magnificent as they say. Don't you agree?

Fear not, dear guest.
We are but humble mummers...
AUGH! Please, no poking! I'm not joking!
Oooh!
Break time's over! Now we make merry!
Wow! Just like a real pudding!
It doesn't bite, does it...?
It's awfully squishy...
What a convincing act you played!
To see our pumpkins decorate Gridania is quite the honor!
Our tireless efforts bore fruit! Or...gourds, I suppose.
Hm. I'd best keep an eye on those fiends...
Kami be praised! The Continental Circus has returned!
Costumed mummers everywhere... Why, I fit right in!
Perhaps I should don a pumpkin head of my own...
Grrrgh... NO! TOUCHING!
Pumpkin heads may just be the stylish addition my wardrobe requires...
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! We just witnessed the most curious sight.
A catfish, walking on its hind legs!
You don't suppose they're like beastmen, do you?
I thought it was rather adorable in any case.
R-Really...?
Good to see you, my friend.
Did you also have trouble reaching the outskirts?
It's a wonder you haven't been zapped to smithereens.
Perish the thought! These boots grant me resistance to paralysis.
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! Why didn't you tell us about this place sooner!?
It's amazing! I've never seen anything like it!
A shame they aren't here to see this.
I'm sure their heart would sing just as ours do.
Dartorgor...is here?
Indeed. She always will be, so long as we remember her.
Hee hee! We love this game!
Getting...dizzy...
We'll need to ensure we have ample supplies.
It's time we prepared the backup systems.
Be ready for anything!
Best we prepare a few contingency plans.
Let's prepare for the worst and hope for the best.
Right. Safety first. Act with due caution.

The storm's worse than we feared...
It's imperative we procure more supplies.

Such violent storms...
We'll need to request lightning rods.

These winds are merciless...
We'll be counting on you!
The areas by the crater are completely frozen...
Glass rain is accumulating at the base of Capsule Chasm!
Sounds like the glass rain's caused some incidents...
Good work, everyone!
That should be it for the repairs... Onto cleanup.
Severe thunderstorms are approaching!
Severe thunderstorms are approaching!
Annealing winds are approaching! We expect temperatures to plummet...
Annealing winds are on their way... Expect severe drops in temperature.
We've got large quantities of glass rain incoming!
We've observed an oncoming glass dust storm...
Our machinery could be in grave danger!
If the storms get too close, we're in trouble...
We'll need to ensure the cave doesn't freeze over...
The frigid air might force a system shutdown...
The way the wind's blowing, the crater might suffer damage.
Take care not to slip on the dust as it approaches.
Please deliver your supplies here!
Seems our job here is done! Let's withdraw.
Seems the alert's been lifted. We'll take care of the rest!
The alert's been lifted! Many thanks for your cooperation.
Now comes the cleanup...
Impeccable timing! The repair supply team is this way!
This is the machine repair hub! Please deliver your supplies here!
That should do it...!
We'll need all the help we can get in the plateau!
Good timing! I'll leave the top to you!
You can leave this area to us.
We need assistance in the eastern plateau!
This is a prime opportunity to test our new charging systems!
I pray we get some useful data out of this...
We should be able to utilize the surrounding resources.
We're in dire need of crystal collectors!
By the gods, it's freezing!
Take a break to warm up if you need it.
Mind your step!
Gods, this is dangerous!
Just don't act rashly, and you won't get hurt.
We'll need some assistance harvesting plants and sampling the soil.
A rare specimen indeed...
All right... Time to install these new parts!
Oil suppliers, this way!
Time to show them what you're made of, fishies... Literally.
Dust collectors, over here!
Phew... The tank's nearly filled!
We'll clean this up in one fell swoop.
Now to take some specimens for further study...

The water quality is...
Hmm. Intriguing.
We must needs survey deepwater impesctors in their natural habitat.
Backup supplies will be a necessity...
We should be able to find a use for these...
Glass rain... Astounding, yet vaguely terrifying.
Oh, no... Is the dust filter clogged!?
A “Phaenna” if ever I saw one!
This star is incredible!
Health and safety first! Time for calisthenics!
One, two! Three, four!
Five, six! Seven, eight!
Schedule... Schedule...
...And a few for my comrades on the moon.
A new star! Can you believe it?
I can't wait to start exploring.
And I can't wait for this loaf to be finished...
I wonder what facilities we'll build here!
A proper kitchen, hopefully...
You'll be as pretty as polished glass.
We'll polish till you shine!
What shall come of this, I wonder?
I can't stop the picture fever!
Let's give it our all, everyone!
Aye aye!
Making good progress, I see. Let's keep it up!
Quickly and carefully, please!
Take that, glass!
Rrrgh... The ground is surprisingly tough!
Leave this to me!
This way!
Over here!
To the new Glassblowers' Beacon!
Say, “Carrots, please!”
It's beautiful!
Huzzah!
All right, I'm taking it!
We did a fine job, if I do say so myself.
Try not to blur it this time...
A big step forward.
And a bit of rest, at last.
Just me and my mech. \\<sigh> What precious moments...
Keep up the good work, everyone!
Even the most mundane scenes are worth a snap, in my book!
Keep those inspections thorough!
Take extra care─we can't afford any mistakes!
No issues detected!
I've never seen you trundle so energetically!
You're the cutest mini rover in the fleet!
When you factor in freight costs, we may as well be hauling gold around.
Behold, Phaenna's very own Cosmoliner!
Three, two, one!
Hold still!
You're standing too close! You won't get us all in frame!
Raw materials take precedence! Rations can wait.
Surely they'd make an exception for carrots?
You polish up well, my mechanized friend.
Musn't overlook even the tiniest flaw...
Faultless construction!
Keep on trundlin', little feller!
At last, Phaenna has a sparkling new habitation module!
Looks like we'll be waiting on proper food supplies for a while longer...
\\<sigh> No end in sight to the Archon loaf diet...
Huh? Where've they gotten to this time?
Hellooo?
Tsk, I've never met someone so work-shy!
Nap first, work later...
Take a moment to admire these wonderful facilities!
I don't know about you, but all this glass is starting to look rather appetizing!
Err, I think we'd better get you to the infirmary...
The finest welds on Phaenna─even if I do say so myself!
Slow and steady...
Time to weld like I've never welded before!
Look at our lovely new mech hangar!
I'd say that was a job well done!
Hear, hear!
Now I just need a hot meal...
Looks like a proper base of operations now, eh?
It's all coming together.
Best do some maintenance while we have the time.
Is it properly charged?
Drill's in good shape.
Thanks for always hangin' in there.
Let's wipe it down.
Dirt, begone!
Not even a speck of dust will remain!
Raaah! I'm gonna dig like no one's ever dug before!
The base is truly beginning to take shape!
That's it, I'm taking this up with Mumukko!
She does seem like she's fine with a diet of Archon loaf...
Being fussy about the details is what it means to be an artisan.
When you're careless, it shows up in your work.
J-Just the slightest bit nervous...
Look at the mech hangar, in all its glory!
It'd be nice to get a taste of what this star has to offer.
...Think we can eat an impesctor?
Would you look at the cosmoport now!
Dining on the odd farmed fish is a real treat.
Truly.
I'd forgotten to give it a try.
I saw it earlier! A shipment of supplies from the moon!
You mean food supplies!? Something besides Archon loaf!?
No chips on the blade.
Fully charged and ready to go.
I see some shards of glass jammed in there...
At last, the base is complete!
And so our maiden survey of a star in the cosmos comes to an end...
It was hard work, but I couldn't have asked for a more fascinating environment.
Gods, a hot meal at last!
Slow down, the food isn't running away.
I think someone's had their fill of Archon loaf...
'Tis a blessed thing to enjoy a peaceful meal.
Certainly better than gnawing on Archon loaf as we work.
Carrots, please!
Good work as always, partner.
Let's make it squeaky clean for the next star!
Squeaky! Squeaky!
Need to find the perfect angle...
Materials appear to be running low. Better make a request to the team on the moon.
Even should the sights change, this flavor does not.
What poor signal... Harrumph!
We must take into account the effects of irregular gravity...
Here's to the most picturesque spot on Oizys!
Oh, let me smooth my whiskers first!
Naught can escape its pull...
Seems like everything's in order.
Being this close to an anomaly puts me on edge...
Don't be daft! Ain't like it's gonna suck you into the air.
When the Loporrits start floating, that's our cue to get worried...
Ahh...
It's important to take a breather every now and then!
Almost there!
Looks like you're making great progress.
Here are the supplies you requested.
But... I've brought the supplies she requested!
Oh, dear... Seems the request was double-booked, boys.
Dylise seems so busy these days...
Yeah, but she takes it all in her stride.
Mind how you go!
As for where we gleaners should report for duty...
This should be enough.
Heard anything about our next mission?
What a marvel.
Sediment is clogging the machinery here...
Let me take a look at the tires.
How were the new mechs?
I wish to hurtle, I tell you! Careen through the air with abandon!
...I'm not sure I can record that for your pilot application.
Just needs a few finishing touches.
Followed by...more maintenance!
Damn all this dust...
How did it handle?
Perfectly well! Test flight went swimmingly.
Our team from the Studium should analyze this further.
I doubt we could keep them away!
Perhaps this will mark the beginning of a Faculty of Interstellar Studies.
What can I say? I like to be thorough.
I'm stuffed!
Good. A hearty meal's the very least I can offer.
Should've...taken...the elevator... \\<wheeze>
Magnificent.
No image can do it justice...
How fare the mini rovers?
Prepped and ready for action!
Certainly takes a while to get them going...
Hm. They do resemble carnivorous plants.
We ought to keep thorough records of them.
Remember─leave no drinks uncovered.
We'll need ample provisions for the coastline survey...
Our next mission has arrived!
And about time, too!
Let's see what we've got...
Could you drive me to the base? I'll pay three whole carrots!
Carrots don't buy fuel, friend...
I reckon this pond has potential for aquaculture.
We'd have to conduct thorough water quality checks, of course.
I bet it's teeming with fish!
According to the scans it is...
Materials...check!
Proper polishing...check!
I'm curious about the composition of those minerals in the cliffs...
Will this be enough?
One, two...
Looks like the groundwork's proceeding on schedule!
Hnnnyaaagh!
Right this way!
I've got to haul this all the way up there!?

Almost there!
Just a few steps further!
Onwards and upwards.
The base is coming on in leaps and bounds!
Better check the other side when I'm done.
I hear the construction teams are working wonders!
I hope we're not missing anything...
Sometimes you can't beat a good ol' fashioned inventory check.
It's about time we started work on the opposite platform.
Almost finished!
Just a few more welds!
Carrot: truly the best beverage flavor!

Delicious carroty goodness!
You never fail to please...
Dammit! Sold out again!
I'd love to visit Shadefleet at some point.
I heard it's absolutely stunning.
I could just take the elevator...
Nicely done!
My welds are second to none!
The anomaly has an almost...mystical quality to it.
Need to keep a thorough record of our progress!
What provisions do you need?
Perhaps the crystal had some religious significance?
We need to ensure any expansion preserves the existing ruins.
Quite the task...

Not for the initiative!
We're capable of anything!
Where's this supposed to go?
I heard they're working on new recipes!
The last thing we need is more dubious flavors...
Everyone's hard work, preserved for posterity!
I know it's a lot to ask...
Heh. There's naught in the cosmos a gleaner couldn't procure.
Honestly, that's not even much of an exaggeration.
It's so imposing...
I wonder where they found it.
Can't make heads or tails of this...
Such plenty, such choice...
These are the parts I want you to use for the upgrade!
Forget it. Your request's already been rejected.
I weighed myself the other day, but the anomalies were messing with the reading.
Squeaky clean!
Like a gleaming gemstone...
So, if you check the analytical output...
Ah, I think I get it now.
Zzzzzz...
Have you seen Commandingway?
Err, not lately...
I only asked you to take a quick look...
How was that giant crystal used, exactly?
I think it served as an informational hub for this star.
Analyzing it will be no small feat, then...
We've come this far. Can't give up now!
We should set up a meeting to discuss the next phase of analysis.
Good luck getting hold of Dylise...
